summary: The V5 implementation achieves 30/31 (97%) requirements. All structural requirements pass: MCP data quality is excellent (R1-R4, R9-R10 all PASS), pipeline execution was complete and correct (R5, R6, R7, R8, P1-P4 PASS), document quality is high across all 10 V-dimensions, and the Skill documentation correctly guided the Agent through all 6 S-dimension checks. The single failure is R5b (per-module file coverage): 4 of 25 modules document fewer than 80% of their assigned files (infrastructure 20.5%, testing-test_canvas 30.8%, testing-test_worker 68.4%, testing-test_loops 78.3%). This is a Skill documentation gap, not an Agent error — the QUALITY_STANDARDS.md only enforces project-level coverage (80.1% achieved), with no per-module gate. The fix is straightforward: document in QUALITY_STANDARDS.md that modules exceeding the token budget must include an explicit budget-exceeded notice in their index-fragment (as testing-test_canvas already does correctly), making per-module under-coverage formally acceptable when budget-constrained.
